She looks towards the camera, gesturing with her hands and smiling as she interacts with someone off-camera. On the table, there are various hotpot utensils, a bowl, and a pot. (2) The camera pans to reveal a man in a white cap and t-shirt and a small boy in a yellow t-shirt sitting across from the girl. The man is laughing and talking while the boy watches. The background shows other diners and a service counter where staff members are working. (3) Close-up shots of the girl show her making hand hearts and pointing as she reacts to a song playing. Post-production graphics like blushing cheeks and devil horns appear on her face for comedic effect. The boy is also seen imitating her gestures or playing with items on the table. (4) The focus shifts primarily to the young boy, who begins to dance and gesture enthusiastically in his seat. The girl is seen in the background also dancing along. A restaurant staff member wearing a red uniform and mask stands nearby, looking on and smiling. (5) The video concludes with several quick cuts between the girl and the boy as they continue their playful interaction at the table, with the camera capturing their joyful expressions and energetic movements in the warm restaurant lighting.
